The '''Bryx Sector Force''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]], assigned to the [[Bryx sector/Legends|Bryx sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was created from a local [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdout]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Bryx Freedom Fighters]], which were active in the sector following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horn Ambigene/Legends|Horn Ambigene]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
